name: mte_finetune_extension_2026_09_20
scope: Fixed single-budget exploratory paired fine-tuning on existing tasks. Original observation-only pretraining unchanged; budgeted action labels update a COPY of history and decoder. Frozen primary results retained. No learning or model selection on evaluation episodes.
statistics: Within each environment separate Holm family (visual six, MaMuJoCo three); paired five upstream seeds, mean episode return, t95 and exact two-sided sign-flip. One prespecified decoder seed for MaMuJoCo; not five decoder replications.
sources: Visual native Simple/Graph/Tree and earlier MIF preserved. MaMuJoCo Simple/Graph matched full-visibility accepted route histories; MIF native masked_mobius archive, NOT full-visibility route MIF. Each compared only to its own exact frozen source.
fairness: Same within-method history initialization, decoder initialization, normalization, labels, sampling and updates. Fine-tuned path has additional trainable history parameters; this study does not isolate pretraining benefit against random initialization. Visual six paths follow prior MIF protocol; MaMuJoCo masked valid steps and budgeted validation selection preserved.
stopping: Complete all45 irrespective of sign. Qualification9 smoke paths and45 frozen weight plus original-episode replay gates before formal training. Max four workers only after prior pilot completes and workers exit. Failure stops dispatch, retains partial; no automatic retries of evidence.
